requirements.text: Upon accessing the application, the user should see the main title 'Number To Words Conversion' prominently displayed at the top of the page within an HTML element with the class 'heading'. This title should be visible immediately upon page load, ensuring that users can easily identify the purpose of the application without any additional interaction. The title should be styled according to the CSS rules associated with the 'heading' class, maintaining consistency with the overall design of the application.

The application provides a real-time number-to-words conversion feature. When a user enters a numeric value into the input field with data-testid 'input-box', the system validates the input and displays the corresponding word representation in the output paragraph with data-testid 'output-paragraph'. The input is padded with leading zeros until its length is divisible by 3 before conversion. If the user enters non-numeric characters, the system shows an error message 'Invalid input. Please enter only digits.' styled in red text. For numbers exceeding 15 digits, the system displays a 'Too Large Number.' error message, also in red. If the input is zero, the output displays 'Zero' in black text. For valid numbers with leading zeros, the leading zeros are ignored, and the number is correctly converted and shown in black text.

generated_cases.description: Enter a valid number with leading zeros (e.g., '007') into the input-box and verify that leading zeros are ignored, the number is correctly converted, and shown in black text in the output-paragraph.

generated_cases.title: Convert Valid Standard Number
generated_cases.description: Enter a standard valid numeric value (e.g., '123') into the input-box and verify that the system validates the input, pads it with leading zeros to make its length divisible by 3, and displays the correct word representation in black text.

generated_cases.title: Invalid Input with Too Large Number
generated_cases.description: Enter a number exceeding 15 digits (e.g., '1234567890123456') into the input-box and verify that the system displays the 'Too Large Number.' error message in red text.

generated_cases.title: Input length at lower boundary (0 digits)
generated_cases.description: Verify the system behavior when the input box is empty (0 digits).

generated_cases.title: Input length within lower boundary (1 digit)
generated_cases.description: Verify the conversion for a single valid digit (e.g., '5').

generated_cases.title: Input length at upper boundary (15 digits)
generated_cases.description: Verify the conversion for a maximum allowed 15-digit number.

generated_cases.title: Input length outside upper boundary (16 digits)
generated_cases.description: Verify the system displays 'Too Large Number.' error message for a 16-digit number.

generated_cases.title: Non-numeric Input Error Handling
generated_cases.description: Enter non-numeric characters into the input field with data-testid 'input-box' to verify that the system correctly displays the red error message 'Invalid input. Please enter only digits.'.

generated_cases.title: Overflow Number Input Error Handling
generated_cases.description: Enter a number exceeding 15 digits into the input field with data-testid 'input-box' to verify that the system displays the red error message 'Too Large Number.'.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Convert a valid number to words
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Real-time Number-to-Words Conversion
  The application provides a real-time number-to-words conversion feature. It validates user input and displays the corresponding word representation or an error message.


  Scenario: [Normal] Convert a valid number to words
    Given the "Number To Words Converter" page is loaded
    And the input field with data-testid "input-box" is empty
    When the user enters "123" into the input field with data-testid "input-box"
    Then the output paragraph with data-testid "output-paragraph" displays "One Hundred Twenty Three"
    And the text color of the output paragraph is black

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Partition inputs into valid digits, non-numeric characters, zero, and numbers exceeding 15 digits.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Test values around the 15-digit limit and zero input to ensure correct boundary handling.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible user errors such as entering letters or symbols and extremely large numbers.
